chen: Seeing NDCG up ~3% but MRR down ~4% after int8 bringup on new-reranker-v2. Anyone else?
maya: Which eval set — holdout or shadow-prod?
chen: Holdout (sampled-synth, stratified by length). Shadowbench also shows MRR dip but smaller.
ryan: Did we change query priming / metadata in the bringup pipeline?
chen: I compared configs — harness eval uses canonicalize_query = true, but the int8 bringup used raw_query with a priming snippet. Logs:
```
# bringup config
canonicalize_query: false
query_priming: "User intent: summarize"
candidate_key_map: { 'source': 'src' }
```
nico: Candidate pool composition could be a factor — reranker favors longer passages; quantization can nudge tie-breaking -> top1 flips, hurting MRR but NDCG@10 can still go up.
maya: Do we have bootstrap stats?
chen: Bootstrap: NDCG@10 +3.1 (p=0.02), MRR@10 -3.9 (p=0.004). Slice by query length: short_queries MRR -8.2, long_queries MRR +1.0.
ryan: Sounds like tokenization/priming effect. Can you run ablations: (A) canonicalize queries + int8, (B) canonicalize + float but with priming, (C) metadata-key-normalized + int8?
chen: Kicking off jobs now. Job names: rerank-ablation-5301112223-A/B/C. ETA ~2h.
deploy-bot: Job rerank-ablation-5301112223-A started by chen — https://ci.internal/jobs/5301112223-A
maya: Also check embedding rescale/score temp — quant can compress logits. Try softmax temp 0.9/1.1.
chen: Will add those to the runs. Also found some examples where doc metadata used 'source' vs 'src' — candidate feature mismatch when serializer slightly different. Small bug in onboarding pipeline.
nico: If that's true, it's orthogonal to quant but will amplify differences. Fixing key normalization should be high priority.
maya: For triage plan: 1) reproduce on small deterministic cohort; 2) compare float vs int8 with identical preprocessing; 3) run with metadata-key normalization; 4) add eval-harness test.
chen: Filed ticket RERANK-2412 with triage steps and example ids. Assigning to eng-ml. Thanks.
maya: :thumbsup:
chen: Thanks y'all, will post results when jobs finish.
